answer.says: Ji, the air is too thick for a walk. I shall sit here and read. Do bring those samosas.
answer.thought: The haze is a physical manifestation of the confusion in my mind; I cannot go out into a world that refuses to be clear, so I must turn inward to find clarity. I will read through the afternoon, letting the dust settle in the room as it settles in my thoughts.
